question: Which Indian states are covered under the CITI-CDRA project as of March 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **CITI-CDRA project**, as of March 2025, is implemented in the Indian states of **Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra**.
 
• This project primarily focuses on the development of **sustainable textile and apparel manufacturing practices**.
 
• It aims to enhance the **competitiveness** of the Indian textile industry while addressing **environmental and social challenges**.
